d: A sleek, saucer-shaped UFO with a glossy jet-black metallic finish, featuring a wide disc-like body and two large spherical pods attached to the underside. The craft emits a brilliant, conical beam of pale yellow light from its center, lifting a small patch of lush green grass and a black-and-white spotted cow. The overall design is minimalist and futuristic with a polished, reflective surface. BODY COLOR: jet-black
